options.why: The last character may be ordinary field data; the contract identifies where the unmatched quote opened.
opening records the original one-based quote column, which is returned if the line ends in QUOTED.
This task does not report a synthetic end column for an unterminated quote; it reports the real opener.
A preceding comma can separate fields but is not the quoted field's unmatched opening delimiter.

items.explanation: The task explicitly reports the opener.
